title: Wars of the Roses
summary: A series of dynastic civil wars in England between the houses of Lancaster and York, both descended from Edward III. Beginning at St. Albans in 1455, they shook the nobility and ended with Henry Tudor's victory at Bosworth, after which his marriage united the two houses and began the Tudor line.
